title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: when a further notice of loss may be lodged on a cover
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs a further loss on a shipment whose cover already carries a claim, and when a further notice may be lodged on that cover.

## Rule

1. Each notice names one container and one loss. A loss found in another container of the same shipment is never added to a claim file already on the cover; it needs a notice of its own.
2. A further notice can be lodged on a cover only when no claim is open on it.
3. A claim still open on the cover whose documents are complete is decided by the desk before the further notice is lodged.
4. A claim still awaiting its documents keeps the cover closed to further notices until it is decided or withdrawn.

## Entry condition for a further notice

No claim is open on the cover when the further notice is lodged, the claim that was open with its documents complete having been decided.

## Condition table

| Claim already on the cover | Further notice |
|---|---|
| None open | May be lodged, subject to the lodging conditions |
| Open, documents complete | Lodged only after the desk has decided the open claim |
| Open, still awaiting documents | Not lodged until that claim is decided or withdrawn |

## Hypothetical cases

- **Case A (hypothetical):** a claim for wet damage in one container is open with its documents complete, and the claimant reports crushed goods in a second container. The second loss is not added to the open file; it needs its own notice, and that notice is lodged only once the open claim has been decided.
- **Case B (hypothetical):** the open claim is still awaiting its documents. The cover stays closed to the further notice until the open claim is decided or withdrawn.
